# Account Owners: Get an Existing Taxbit Account Owner

Area overview and notes: [account-owners.md](../account-owners.md)

`GET /account-owners/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Get data stored for an Account Owner that exists in Taxbit's system (as an object).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |

**Response 200**: Fetch Account Owner was successful

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |
| `data.taxbit_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The Taxbit ID for this object. This is a version 4 UUID. |
| `data.tenant_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | Tenant ID for your organization. |
| `data.date_created` | string (date-time) | Yes | The date when the account owner was created in Taxbit's system. |
| `data.date_modified` | string | Yes |  |
| `data.account_owner_type` | string | No | The type of Account Owner. One of: `INDIVIDUAL`, `ENTITY`, `INTERMEDIARY`. |
| `data.prefers_physical_mail` | boolean | No | Whether the Account Owner's tax forms are sent through physical mail instead of electronically. Defaults to false. |
| `data.is_tax_exempt` | boolean | No |  |
| `data.valid_self_certification_on_file` | boolean | No | Whether a valid self-certification is on file for the Account Owner. When a self-certification tax document is on file, this reflects the latest self-certification's validation status; otherwise it reflects the value you provided. |
